verdict.rationale: Navan's pricing page lists "unlimited policy and approval workflows" (navan-docs-25). Its MCP docs say transactions are flagged or declined against policies and routed to approvers (navan-docs-22), which amounts to built-in rules that act automatically on expense events. The evidence is thin and limited to policy and approval routing, with no documented general rule builder or custom trigger-action configuration. Webhooks (navan-docs-2) are only a developer building block and earn no credit here. missing for 10: a documented user-definable event→action rule engine, a range of configurable triggers and actions beyond policy flagging and approval routing, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
